_about: TOM shape-flow DEM study (ESRIC question: does particle shape improve flowability?). SI units: m, kg, s, Pa. Edit values here, not in the scripts.

particles._note_Crr: Rolling resistance, applied to grain-grain and grain-6061 pairs; grain-slice is 0. Same value for every level (no per-level tuning); deviations from 42 - 17R are reported as model error. Calibration on the rough-floor slump test, L0, mu 0.6: Crr 0.25 gave 40.35 deg (seed 1). 2026-11-05: 3-seed L0 mean 41.54 +- 0.67 deg (SE) at Crr 0.25; Crr set to 0.22 by interpolation to 40 deg (slope ~0.44 deg per 0.01 Crr). See results/methods_log.md.
particles._note_mu: Fixed at 0.6 (2026-11-04). The L0 angle of repose is calibrated with Crr (rolling resistance) instead; mu alone gave 28 deg at 0.6 on the rough-floor slump test.

walls._note_mu_particle_wall: Estimate, smooth 6061 vs 2 mm angular grains, ~19 deg. Brackets 0.25 and 0.50. Replace with tilt test.

cohesion._model: DEME packaged ForceModelWithCohesion.cu: extra pull = C x effective mass while grains touch. For two equal grains Bo = C / (2 g).
cohesion._note_multiplicity: DEME applies the pull per touching sphere pair, so C is divided by the mean number of sphere pairs per touching grain pair. Every non-cohesive hopper run measures it after the fill; Phase D reads it from those runs, or from sphere_pairs_per_contact below if you fill it in.

chute._frame: x down the slope along the floor, y across, z normal to the floor (floor at z = 0). The angle is set by tilting gravity.
chute._note_feed_fraction_min: A run only scores as flowing if the delivered feed over the score window is at least this fraction of feed_rate_kg_s.

hopper._frame: x across the hopper, y through the slice (0 to slice_m), z up; slot outlet at z = 0, centred on x = 0.
hopper._note_times: Flow-run times and windows are for lunar gravity; other gravities scale them by sqrt(1.62 / g).

repose._test: Slump test in a 20 mm slice at 1 g on a rough floor (one fixed layer of same-level grains): a column (aspect 0.5) collapses when its gate is removed; the slope of the heap above the layer is the angle of repose.
repose._note_target: Set to the measured angle of repose of the SRT simulant batch.

phases._note_knee: Set after Phase A (07_postprocess.py suggests one). Phases D and E use L0, the knee level and L5.
